messages:
maria_finance: Heads up — noticed ~120 customers received a SECOND March invoice after last night's nightly-invoice-run. looks like orphaned credit memos retriggered rebilling. sample IDs: inv_004789, inv_004790, cr_01234
devon_billing: ugh. any quick pattern? duplicate amounts or different lineitems?
maria_finance: mostly same amounts. some show a negative credit line + full charge again (so net doubled). example inv_004789 shows original + credit row from cr_01234 but then system reissued charge without consuming the credit.
maria_finance: sample log snippet:
```
2024-03-12T02:01:05Z INFO invoice_job apply_manual_adjustments adjustment_id=cr_01234 invoice_id=NULL action=apply
2024-03-12T02:01:06Z WARN adjustment missing invoice_id, continuing
2024-03-12T02:02:00Z INFO invoice_job generate_invoice created_invoice=inv_004789 from_customer=cust_9001
```
devon_billing: that WARN looks wrong — we should skip adjustments without invoice_id or attach them to the new invoice atomically. who owns apply_manual_adjustments()?
sanjay: that's my module. I think v2.4 introduced a refactor that changed idempotency keys. looks like adjustments with null invoice_id were still being enqueued and then applied after invoice generation.
sanjay: quick query I ran: `SELECT id,customer_id,amount,created_at FROM adjustments WHERE invoice_id IS NULL AND created_at >= '2024-03-12'` returned 128 rows that match customers with a generated invoice row the same minute.
anna_support: we have ~15 open support tickets already. customers confused (billing email) — some called it a duplicate charge. need a communication plan.
devon_billing: can we roll a hotfix? block new runs and regenerate corrections?
sanjay: I'll patch today — plan: 1) short-circuit apply_manual_adjustments when invoice_id IS NULL 2) add idempotency key based on adjustment.id + run_id 3) add integration test for concurrent apply+generate.
sanjay: will push a PR in 30m.
deploy-bot: staging-deploy invoice-job-v2.4.1 started by sanjay at 2024-03-12T09:20Z
deploy-bot: staging-deploy succeeded, running smoke tests
/devon_billing: once patched can we regenerate invoices for affected customers? prefer regenerating with credits applied rather than issuing refunds. timeline?
maria_finance: I made a csv with impacted customer_ids and invoice IDs and uploaded to finance-drive/batch_241999. we can use that to drive a regen job.
anna_support: I'll send the draft note to customers for review — recommending we void the duplicate invoice and mark the other one as final after regen. CC legal.
sanjay: timeline: patch + prod deploy tonight UTC, regen job tomorrow morning, email after regen. I'll also add a reconciliation flag so we can find any orphan credits in the future.
devon_billing: sounds good. please escalate if regen will create more edge cases.
maria_finance: created internal ticket FIN-5492 and linked support batch. keeping this thread updated. thanks all :heart:
